mapper.select: SELECT TRANSFERYEAR, RC_RFILE_NO, RC_RITEM_NO, MNGNO, DETNO, DETCONNNO, KIKWANCODE, PRODYEAR, OPN_YN, ORG_FILE_PATH, ORG_FILE_NAME, SAVE_FILE_NAME, DEL_YN, CHK_YN, FST_REG_DT, FST_REG_ID, LST_UPD_DT, LST_UPD_ID FROM CN_ELEC_DOC WHERE TRANSFERYEAR = #{transferYear} AND COALESCE(DEL_YN, 'N') != 'Y' AND COALESCE(SAVE_FILE_NAME, ORG_FILE_NAME) IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM EXTRACT_ELEC_DOC E WHERE E.FILE_NAME = COALESCE(CN_ELEC_DOC.SAVE_FILE_NAME, CN_ELEC_DOC.ORG_FILE_NAME) AND E.RC_RFILE_NO = CN_ELEC_DOC.RC_RFILE_NO AND E.RC_RITEM_NO = CN_ELEC_DOC.RC_RITEM_NO AND E.EXTRACT_STATUS = 'PASS' ) ORDER BY RC_RFILE_NO, RC_RITEM_NO, COALESCE(SAVE_FILE_NAME, ORG_FILE_NAME) LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EXTRACT_ELEC_DOC ( FILE_NAME, RC_RFILE_NO, RC_RITEM_NO, CONTENTS, IMG_DATAS, FILE_TYPE, FILE_GUBUN, INDEXING_CONTENTS, HWP_SUB_TITLE, DATA_YEAR, QUEUE_STATE, HAS_CONTENTS, EXTRACT_STATUS, EXTRACT_ERR_MSG, CREATE_DATE, UPDATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{fileName}, #{rcRfileNo}, #{rcRitemNo}, #{contents}, #{imgDatas}, #{fileType}, #{fileGubun}, #{indexingContents}, #{hwpSubTitle}, #{dataYear}, #{queueState}, #{hasContents}, #{extractStatus}, #{extractErrMsg}, NOW(), NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE CONTENTS = VALUES(CONTENTS), IMG_DATAS = VALUES(IMG_DATAS), FILE_TYPE = VALUES(FILE_TYPE), FILE_GUBUN = VALUES(FILE_GUBUN), INDEXING_CONTENTS = VALUES(INDEXING_CONTENTS), HWP_SUB_TITLE = VALUES(HWP_SUB_TITLE), DATA_YEAR = VALUES(DATA_YEAR), QUEUE_STATE = VALUES(QUEUE_STATE), HAS_CONTENTS = VALUES(HAS_CONTENTS), EXTRACT_STATUS = VALUES(EXTRACT_STATUS), EXTRACT_ERR_MSG = VALUES(EXTRACT_ERR_MSG), UPDATE_DATE = NOW()
